card.name: Comma in angioedema and malaise lists
card.fires_on: The comma right after the first item in a memorized warning list: "Angioedema of the face" or "symptoms such as malaise". It fires where the next list item is a fixed, expected word.

modes.label: Angioedema face list
modes.description: Comma after "face" in the phrase describing swelling of the face, lips, tongue and throat.
modes.example: Angioedema Angioedema of the face<<,>> extremities, lips, tongue, gl

modes.label: Lactic acidosis symptoms
modes.description: Comma after "malaise" in the list of nonspecific symptoms of metformin-associated lactic acidosis.
modes.example: accompanied only by nonspecific symptoms such as malaise<<,>> myalgias, respiratory distress, som

card.plain: It marks the comma in two stock warning lists, where the next symptom or body part is highly predictable.
